text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since the trouble 
at the shopping district. While Haru Urara 
is as cheerful as ever, she seems unable 
to shake off a lingering uneasiness.

Then, one day, while walking along the 
riverbank……

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. The sunset is so pretty...

Haru Urara was gazing blankly at the 
sunset. As expected, she seemed a bit 
dispirited. Just as I was wondering how to 
call out to her...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh, Rice? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... well, you see, the truth is, I 
followed Urara-chan all the way from the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, really? I didn't notice at all!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry...! Um, Urara-chan just seemed 
so down, so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice might not be very dependable, 
but... if you'd like... would you talk to 
me?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I see. You got scolded for not taking 
it seriously, huh.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I didn't really get it. So I 
couldn't say anything at all.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"What does it mean to be serious? Is it 
not enough to just run for fun?"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel like I can't let things stay 
like this. But, but, what in the world 
should I do~?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I think, my brain just goes boom! 
It just explodes, like KABOOM--!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, l-let's calm down first, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Urrgh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, this might be a little 
different, but... Rice has been scolded 
before too, you know."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice won... in a race that meant so much 
to someone else.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And then, I heard sighs of disappointment. 
There were so many angry people, too...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Rice-chan...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Still, Rice tried her very best.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I was going to be blown away 
by all the sighs, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I ran a lot, and won a whole bunch. And 
then, you know..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Before Rice even realized it, more and 
more people were telling her, 
"Congratulations!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Then maybe I should try even harder 
too?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"If I try even harder, will everyone stop 
being sad?"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if she'll stop thinking, 'I 
don't want you to run,' too?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Urara-chan, you said before that you 
wanted to win, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because—I want to win! If I don't run, I 
can't win, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You know, I want everyone to see me win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then I think you're just fine the way you 
are.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If you truly want to win, Urara-chan, I'm 
sure... everything will be alright.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...? This is too hard~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm really bad at thinking stuff 
through! So I'll just listen to what 
Rice-chan says!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thank you... If it's you, 
Urara-chan, you'll be just fine.

After talking with Rice Shower, Haru Urara 
seemed to have regained her spirits.
